_source: Static UI keys for the mobile PM close summary (route pm-close, pototype/mobile-pm.jsx MPMClose L181-217). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS (the approvals_inbox / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent): fields marked dict below are stable ids read with t() (checkProgress with tf(), it carries {n}/{count}); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). Every prototype line number here was re-grepped against the raw .jsx this round and each value byte-verified (glyph by glyph: the row-2 separator and the composed 'ผลตรวจ' value use ASCII middot U+00B7, the 'เริ่ม-เสร็จ' label uses ASCII hyphen U+002D — the en-dash U+2013 in the prototype's VALUE '09:14 – 10:48 น.' is mock data, never keyed). ZERO-MINT WHERE POSSIBLE — 5 of the 12 slots resolve today because the merged web PM screens render this same close panel: rowAsset=pm.fieldAsset 'อุปกรณ์' (L201) · rowTotalTime=pm.timeTotal 'รวมเวลา' (L201) · signatureTitle=pm.signatureLabel 'ลายเซ็นลูกค้า / ผู้ดูแลอาคาร' (L205) — all three byte-identical to the prototype — plus checkProgress=pm.checkProgress '{n}/{count} รายการ', whose shape is exactly the prototype's '5/5 รายการ' (L201), and rowParts='อะไหล่' which already exists in the phrases layer (L201). 6 values are net-new and staged in agents/orch-d-recon/pm-close-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): title 'สรุป + ปิดงาน' (L197) · summaryTitle 'สรุปงาน' (L200) · rowChecks 'ผลตรวจ' (L201) · rowTime 'เริ่ม-เสร็จ' (L201) · repairCount 'ซ่อม {n}' (the parameterised form of the prototype's 'ซ่อม 1', L201 — the pm_checklist 'ตรวจแล้ว {n}/{count}' precedent) · recipient 'ผู้รับบริการ' (L209). Each already resolves in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th — the pm_jobs / st_grlist / notif / approve / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent) and lights up en/zh/ar once applied. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — four prototype strings are DROPPED rather than keyed, because each is a CLAIM and a claim cannot be em-dashed the way a missing value can: (1) the success-view heading (L189, 'ปิดงาน PM สำเร็จ') announces a completion status that has no column — pm_workorder has NO status and NO certificate column and the close handler never invents one (apps/api/src/routes/pm.ts L753-760); (2) the success-view subtitle's second line (L190, 'ส่งใบรับรองผล PM ให้ลูกค้าผ่าน LINE แล้ว') states a certificate was pushed to the customer over LINE — lineNotifyStub is a verified no-op (B-108b) and no certificate exists to send; (3) the CTA label (L213, 'ปิดงาน PM + ส่งรายงาน') carries that same report-send promise, so it is replaced by the existing dict key pm.closeWithSignBtn on a control that is permanently DISABLED (BLOCKERS.md B-288); (4) the empty pad's hint (L207, 'แตะเพื่อให้ลูกค้าลงนาม' — 'tap to have the customer sign') promises an interaction that does not exist, since the pad is inert. The whole success view (L185-194) is dropped with them and is unreachable anyway: it is entered by a close this screen cannot perform.
_layers: dict (t): rowAsset · rowTotalTime · signatureTitle · close. dict (tf): checkProgress. phrases (tp): title · summaryTitle · rowChecks · rowTime · rowParts · repairCount · recipient.
